IT IS UNKNOWN THE AMOUNT THAT WENT INTO THE SEWER SYSTEM.. /// UPDATE TO NRC REPORT #1376853 /// UPDATE IS AS FOLLOWS: CALLER STATES THAT THE MATERIAL RELEASED IS BEING UPDATED: UP-50 WORK SOLUTION WITH ULS #2 HEATING OIL. THE MATERIAL RELEASED MOSTLY INTO CONTAINMENT BUT SOME OF THE PRODUCT MADE IT INTO THE SOIL AND GRAVEL AROUND THE FACILITY.

Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: HANNECK CLEANERS
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 39.674270, -104.940058 (Approximated from street_address)
Report Description
CALLER STATED THEY WERE RETAINED BY THE PROPERTY OWNER WHICH IS WELSHIRE PLAZA LLC, TO DO AN INVESTIGATION BECAUSE OF THE PRESENCE OF THE FORMER DRY CLEANING OPERATION. CALLER STATED THEY DRILLED TWO BORINGS AND COLLECTED SOIL SAMPLES. CALLER STATED THEY ALSO INSTALLED TWO MONITORING WELLS AND COLLECTED GROUND WATER SAMPLES. CALLER STATED THEY ALSO COLLECTED INDOOR AIR SAMPLES AT THE UNIT. CALLER STATED LAB RESULTS DID NOT DETECT ANYTHING IN THE INDOOR AIR BASED ON RESULTS RECIEVED ON 19-JUN-2018. CALLER STATED LAB RESULTS FOUND A TRACE OF TETRACHLOROETHENE (PCE) IN ONE SOIL SAMPLE BASED ON RESULTS RECIEVED ON 19-JUN-2018 . CALLER STATED THAT LAB RESULTS DETECTED ONE OF THE GROUND WATER SAMPLES CONTAINED 1700 MICROGRAMS PER LITER OF PCE AND 1100 MICROGRAMS PER LITER OF TRICHLOROETHENE (TCE) BASED ON RESULTS RECIEVED ON 28-JUN-2018.

Report DescriptionCALLER IS MAKING A REPORT INVOLVING A POWER BANK THAT CAUGHT FIRE AND STARTED SMOKING WHILE ONBOARD A FLIGHT GOING TO LOS ANGELES, CA FROM MUNICH, GERMANY. CALLER STATES THE POWER BANK WAS DROPPED ON THE FLOOR OF THE AIRCRAFT AND WHEN THE PASSENGER MOVED THEIR SEAT, THEY ACTUALLY MOVED THE SEAT OVER THE POWER BANK AND THEN IT CAUGHT ON FIRE. WHEN THE INCIDENT OCCURRED THE AIRCRAFT WAS ABOVE SALT LAKE CITY, UT HEADING TO LOS ANGELES. THE AIRCRAFT WAS DIVERTED TO THE SALT LAKE CITY AIRPORT TO MAKE AN EMERGENCY LANDING. THE FIRE WAS PUT OUT BY THE FLIGHT CREW AND THE ITEM WAS PLACED INTO A THERMAL BAG. FIRE DEPT RESPONDED AND TOOK POSSESSION OF THE ITEM. THE AIRCRAFT WAS REFUELED AT SALT LAKE CITY AIRPORT AND WAS SAFE TO PROCEED TO LOS ANGELES, CA. AIRCRAFT SAFELY LANDED IN LOS ANGELES, CA AT 2040 EST ON 27-FEB-2026. FLIGHT NUMBER: LH452 SEAT NUMBER: 4A

ORIGINAL REPORTED INFO IS AS FOLLOWS: CALLER IS REPORTING A SPILL NITRIC ACID AT A MANUFACTURING FACILITY WAREHOUSE DUE TO A FAULTY HOSE WHILE LOADING A TRUCK. CALLER STATED THE SPILL WENT TO THE FLOOR INSIDE OF THE WAREHOUSE AND THEN TO AN ONSITE SUMP. CALLER STATED THERE WAS NO OFFSITE LIQUID IMPACT.
